title: Auto-anatomist network
summary: The auto-anatomist's 3-D network: a residual U-Net, a plain U-Net or a probe, with its widths and groups.
does: The model spot of the auto-anatomist (vendored from bordercall under grid/autoanatomist/, merged with #483; its keys are grid/autoanatomist/autoanatomist/blocks.py): residual-unet, plain-unet or probe, the encoders' channels at three scales (the key widths, default 16:32:64) and group norm's groups (default 8). It reads CT crops around each vertebra with the privileged mask channels its trainer anneals away. AutoanatomistFlow runs it inside the fixed plans under grid/screens/.

outputs.name: model
outputs.what: The network, shaped by the crops it will read.

params.name: architecture
params.what: the network the model spot takes

params.name: width_1
params.what: the encoders' channels at the first scale (widths=a:b:c); 1024 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: width_2
params.what: the encoders' channels at the second scale; 1024 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: width_3
params.what: the encoders' channels at the third scale; 1024 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: groups
params.what: group norm's groups; 64 is the sandbox's cap

nondeterminism: The new head starts from a random draw made under its trainer's seed, so the network repeats only with that seed.

generic.why: It reads 3-D CT crops around each vertebra (#483); 2-D frames would need a 2-D U-Net and crops of their own.

today.note: Merged with #483: the gate word `autoanatomist <plan>` runs AutoanatomistFlow over a fixed plan under grid/screens/ (gold3_latent_smoke, gold3_latent_screen), under docs/research/autoanatomist-screen/PREREG.md. A plan of the sandbox's own waits on the pipeline route (README section 8).
